name: Libri-Light: A Benchmark for ASR with Limited or No Supervision
description: Libri-Light is a massive speech dataset for self-supervised learning, unsupervised representations, and automatic speech recognition (ASR) with minimal supervision. Sourced from LibriVox public-domain audiobooks, it provides 60,000+ hours of unsegmented English speech audio alongside standard subsets (60k hours, 6k hours, 600 hours) and small supervision splits (10 hours, 1 hour, 10 minutes), establishing a benchmark for foundation acoustic models like wav2vec 2.0.
